items.title: A Noetherian local ring that is not formally catenary is not universally catenary
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)

items.difficulty_reason: statement 只有一句（非形式化的 Noetherian 局部环不是万有链环），证明却是一段真正的双向归纳：先把环约化到整环、把完备化中「维度最小的极小素理想处维数 d」当作归纳量；d=1 时要用「幂零理想使完备化成商」构造有限型扩张 B，再用维数公式与超越次数推出矛盾；d>1 时要用素理想回避挑一个元素把 d 降下去。承重演算（维数、超越次数、回避、归纳传递）都在 span 内做完；4 处引用里 1 处同章、3 处跨章，全部导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-not-formally-catenary (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 32324-32328

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reduction to the domain case with a minimal prime over the completion of minimal dimension one or more, the case of dimension one where a finite extension of the ring with a prescribed completion contradicts the dimension formula, and the induction that cuts the dimension down by an element outside finitely many primes (source lines 32330-32386)
